page.layout: Full page: running head and page number at top; one engraved oval portrait with circular legend around it; below the portrait a four-line verse caption, centred; signature at foot right of centre. No text columns or margin notes.

main_text.p: [Engraving: oval portrait of Philippus III with legend "PHILIPPVS III. DEI GRATIA HISPANIARVM ET INDIARVM REX etc." around it; described under notes.]

Tertius obtinui Regnorum sceptra Philippus
Diuitiis de Marte potens, mihi decolor Indus
Et tumidus mihi paret Iber, mihi perfidus hostis
Seruit, & indomiti submittunt colla Sicambri.

page.notes: The oval engraving carries the legend "PHILIPPVS III. DEI GRATIA HISPANIARVM ET INDIARVM REX etc." running around its border. The verse caption is set in italic type. The signature mark is "S 4". The verse is transcribed as printed; "Tertius" and "obtinui" as read from the scan. The line "Seruit, & indomiti submittunt colla Sicambri" is read with some uncertainty in its last word.
